title: Longest Nice Subarray
summary: Given an array of positive integers, find the longest subarray where the bitwise AND of any two distinct elements is zero.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, find the longest subarray where the bitwise AND of any two distinct elements is zero. Return the length of this subarray.
constraints: A subarray is nice when every pair of distinct elements has bitwise AND zero.
The chosen values must be contiguous.
Return the maximum nice subarray length.
hints: In a nice window, OR and XOR of its values describe the same set of occupied bits.
Maintain a bit mask for the current window.
While a new value overlaps the mask, remove left values with XOR; then OR in the new value and update the best length.
Because retained values have disjoint bits, XOR removes exactly one value’s bits, and shrinking to no overlap restores the invariant.
editorial: Because retained values have disjoint bits, XOR removes exactly one value’s bits, and shrinking to no overlap restores the invariant.

tests.explanation: The subarray [3,8,48] has disjoint set bits and length three.
Every pair of adjacent candidates conflicts, so the maximum length is one.
